verdict.rationale: Sentry has an 'Issue Status' triage docs page (states-triage), 'Ownership Rules' for assigning owners, a bulk-mutate issues API, and MCP-based issue triaging. That establishes first-party triage features, but the evidence is mostly page titles and doesn't spell out the specific actions or regression behavior. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of resolve/ignore/snooze actions, documented automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
